audience.text: Python developers building data processing, reporting, or automation workflows that require reading, writing, or transforming Excel workbooks without Microsoft Excel dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create, load, and save .xlsx workbooks using the Workbook class and worksheet/cell APIs.
capabilities.title: Read and write Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Apply fonts, fills, borders, alignment, and number formats to cells using Style and Font objects.
capabilities.title: Cell formatting and styling

capabilities.text: Add list, number, date, and other validation types to cell ranges and configure alert styles.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional rules

capabilities.text: Export workbooks to CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown, and PDF formats using built-in exporters.
capabilities.title: Export to multiple formats

capabilities.text: Protect workbooks with passwords using standard and agile encryption parameters.
capabilities.title: Workbook encryption

capabilities.text: Create and manage charts, pictures, shapes, tables, and sparklines within workbooks.
capabilities.title: Chart and shape support

capabilities.text: Preserve formula expressions and cached results during load/save operations.
capabilities.title: Formula and calculation preservation

capabilities.text: Load CSV data into workbooks using Workbook.load_csv() or load_csv_workbook() functions.
capabilities.title: Import CSV data

limitations.text: This project is not a full Excel calculation engine; formula expressions are preserved but not evaluated.
Native loading and saving targets the Open XML .xlsx format; .xls, .ods, and .xlsb are not supported.
Some advanced Excel features are preserved as source package parts rather than exposed as editable Python objects.
PDF output depends on locally available fonts and the optional skia-python renderer.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in pure Python, avoiding reliance on Microsoft Excel or COM interop.
Supports common spreadsheet operations such as cell value management, formatting, data validation, and chart creation.
Provides export to multiple formats including CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown, and PDF for interoperability and reporting.
Enables workbook encryption and decryption using standard and agile encryption parameters for secure data handling.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Python is a free, open-source, pure-Python library for creating, reading, modifying, and exporting Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.
